skill.name: google-maps-reviews-api-skill
skill.description: Extract Google Maps reviews through BrowserAct's workflow API using keywords, language, and country settings.
skill.summary: Run BrowserAct review extraction for Google Maps searches.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs expected outbound requests to BrowserAct and reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY for authentication. Most markdown backtick and system-reconnaissance detections are false positives, but credential handling and command execution are real. The main additional risk is guidance that may cause users to paste API keys into chat.

remediation.issue: API key sharing guidance can expose credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an environment variable or approved secret store. Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat.

remediation.issue: The skill sends queries and credentials to a third-party API.
remediation.suggestion: Document the BrowserAct endpoint, data sent, and privacy expectations. Require user consent before sending business or reviewer data.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to run a local Python command.
remediation.suggestion: Use argument-array invocation when possible, validate language and country values, and avoid interpolating raw user text into shell commands.

remediation.issue: Result retrieval appears unreachable after the polling loop.
remediation.suggestion: Move the timeout return into a loop else branch or only return on timeout. Verify that finished tasks continue to result retrieval.

content.value_statement: Manual Google Maps review collection is slow and hard to compare across locations. This skill runs BrowserAct's review workflow and returns structured review fields for analysis.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct workflow template for Google Maps review extraction.
Sends search keywords, language, and country as input parameters.
Polls task status and prints timestamped progress messages.
Reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment before authenticated requests.
Contains result parsing for author, rating, text, date, likes, and avatar fields.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key and outbound network access.
Review availability depends on Google Maps and BrowserAct workflow results.
The current script should be fixed because result retrieval appears unreachable.
It does not perform sentiment analysis unless the agent analyzes returned reviews separately.

use_cases.description: Collect reviews for one location and summarize common praise, complaints, and rating patterns.

use_cases.title: Compare Local Competitors

use_cases.title: Qualify Service Leads
use_cases.description: Review public feedback for service providers before outreach or partnership research.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Review Pull

prompt_templates.title: Location Feedback Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Summarize feedback for a named business.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to retrieve reviews for 'Acme Dental Boston' in English for the United States. Summarize ratings and common issues.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Review Benchmark
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill for three competitor search terms in Toronto. Compare review themes, rating patterns, and recurring complaints.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Region Review Study
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to collect reviews for 'electric vehicle charging stations' in us, ca, and gb. Highlight regional sentiment differences.

output_examples.input: Collect reviews for dental clinic in Seattle with language en and country us.
output: Review set with reviewer names, star ratings, review text, dates, likes, and profile links.
Short summary of frequent praise, common complaints, and notable low-rating themes.

output_examples.input: Compare reviews for three coffee shop searches in Austin.
output: Side-by-side comparison of rating patterns and repeated customer themes.
List of locations with strong service signals and locations with recurring complaints.

output_examples.input: Gather reviews for a retail chain location before a quality audit.
output_examples.output: A concise briefing with recent review themes, quoted concerns, rating distribution notes, and follow-up questions for the audit team.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in an environment variable or approved secret store.
Confirm that review collection follows platform terms and local privacy rules.
Use narrow search terms and country settings to reduce irrelevant results.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared logs.
Do not run broad scraping requests without a clear business purpose.
Do not treat public reviews as private customer records without verification.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY for authenticated BrowserAct API requests.

faq.question: Does it browse Google Maps directly?
faq.answer: No. The script calls a BrowserAct workflow API that performs the review extraction.

faq.question: What inputs does it accept?
faq.answer: It accepts search keywords, language, and country. Keywords are required, while language and country have defaults.

faq.question: Can it analyze sentiment?
faq.answer: It collects review text. The agent can summarize sentiment after reviews are returned.

faq.question: What review fields can appear?
faq.answer: Output may include reviewer names, profile URLs, ratings, text, dates, likes, and avatar URLs.

faq.question: What should users check before running it?
faq.answer: Users should confirm API key handling, data privacy requirements, and BrowserAct account permissions.
